widget_mechanic: When a plus-chip filter is set (e.g. '3+ bedrooms'), results include all N ≥ 3. To require EXACTLY N, agent must locate and enable the 'use exact match' toggle — usually below the plus-chip row or inside an advanced filters panel.

source_inspiration.instruction: I'm looking to buy a move-in ready home with 3 bedrooms and central AC in Jackson, TN, priced between $300k and $600k. Can you help me find one that meets these criteria?
source_inspiration.first_failure_summary: [3.5] Incomplete task execution: The double-click was on the correct Realtor.com result link, but the post-action screenshot shows no navigation or observable change, so the action did not advance the task.
